Anti-Library

What’s an anti-library? I like to explore it as tsundoku, defined below:

Tsundoku (積ん読) is the phenomenon of acquiring reading materials but letting them pile up in one’s home without reading them. The term is also used to refer to unread books on a bookshelf meant for reading later. (wikipedias)
